items.reason: Both describe the compatibility break caused by adding abstract order() to CryptoProvider without a default implementation.
Both describe missing signature-length validation in concatenatedRSToASN1DER, causing short-input exceptions and trailing-byte truncation.
Describes ASN1Decoder.readSequence accepting invalid sequence boundaries and trailing data, which no golden issue covers.
Both describe equal-priority crypto providers being selected by ServiceLoader order instead of rejecting an ambiguous configuration.
Describes AuthzClient initialization permanently selecting a global provider from a restricted classloader view. This differs from the golden issue about tied provider priorities.
Both describe a self-consistency-only converter test that lacks independent verification of the re-encoded DER signature.
Both identify the discarded ASN1Encoder writes that redundantly encode r and s before the return expression encodes them again.
Both describe missing input-length validation before array copies in concatenatedRSToASN1DER and the resulting unchecked exception on short signatures.
Describes integerToBytes accepting negative or oversized DER integers and silently changing their values through padding or truncation. No golden issue covers this integer-conversion problem.
Describes the same missing sequence-boundary and trailing-data validation in ASN1Decoder.readSequence as S3.
